Takeaways (two choices inherited from the base repo, left unchanged)
• REDQ critics (10 Q-nets + shared ResNet-34): 20 steps per update.
• Residual actor + temperature: 1 step per update.
: LoRA adapters, flow-matching loss on successes
gets no gradient from the critic.
• The critic acts at selection time (argmax over 16 candidates).
• 1 update per episode, batch 24, UTD 20: the ManiSkill YAML
settings (push / pick / stack), reused as is for FORGE.
• The paper says ≈ 1 update per 40 steps and batch 64; the base
repo does not use these values, so we do not change them.
• Only FORGE-specific effect: 150-step episodes instead of 120.
• openpi freeze filter (gemma_2b_lora) identical to the base
repo: LLM outside LoRA frozen, everything else trainable.
• The paper describes a frozen image encoder; the reference
code does not do it, so we follow the code.
